reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `dedupe-imports` against `main`:

*P1 — Overlapping contacts aren’t deduped by ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` compares object identity, not `contact.id`. Separate imports containing `{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }` and `{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }` retain both records through `mergeImports`, violating the documented first-seen-per-ID behavior.

*Recommended fix:* Track seen IDs and retain only the first contact for each ID. Add regression tests for distinct objects sharing an ID, both directly in `dedupe` and across lists in `mergeImports`.

All 4 existing tests pass; a separate overlap reproduction fails. `test/dedupe.test.js` only tests repeated references and distinct IDs, so it misses this case.

No files changed.
